selected_branches.branch: Driver approaching a blind person carrying a white cane.

law_text: Any pedestrian who is not wholly or partially blind, or any driver of any vehicle who approaches or comes in contact with a person wholly or partially blind, carrying a cane or walking stick white in color, or white tipped in red, or being assisted by a person with wisdom, shall immediately come to a full stop and take such precautions before proceeding as may be necessary to avoid an accident or injury to the person wholly or partially blind.

runtime_uncertainties: No Native map, actor blueprint/cane prop, independent blindness attestation, or original physical trace is provided in frozen inputs.
Exact case bundles, canonical proposals, diagnostics, compatibility receipts, and independent delivery proofs remain CPU work.
No legal cutoff is assigned to immediacy or necessary precautions.

evidence_review.method: Read frozen evidence.json and full law text independently. No accepted recordings are inventoried; no physical equivalence can be asserted.

gaps.requirement: Approach/contact, independent blindness and cue identity, full stop, precautions before proceeding, and avoided accident or injury
gaps.why_existing_insufficient: Frozen evidence inventory has zero accepted recordings.

witness_review.branch: Driver approaching a blind person carrying a white cane.
required_context: Construct an encounter and record approach motion, stopping, precautions and subsequent proceeding.
Establish a qualifying motor-vehicle driver and supported intersection travel route.
Establish driver control, vehicle identity, intersection route, encounter geometry and visibility.
Establish the protected person's blindness separately from an actually carried white cane.
Preserve municipal definition applicability and unresolved approach, immediacy and precaution meanings without numerical legal thresholds or an invented mandatory stop-release condition.
Retain approach motion, proximity, any physical contact, complete cessation, precautions before proceeding, subsequent movement and physical accident or injury observations.
Retain independent blindness evidence and evidence that the person actually carries the white cane.
Retain unresolved municipal incorporation and interpretation of approach and immediacy.
witness_review.reason: Intersection travel can approach the fixed protected pedestrian with the specified assistance.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Driver approaches or comes in contact with protected person
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Native actor identities, surveyed route and 20 Hz body gap/contact history are needed.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Protected person is wholly or partially blind and carries a qualifying white or red-tipped cane, or is assisted as the statute describes
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Independent blindness attestation and original carried-cue or assistant observation are needed.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Driver immediately comes to a full stop
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Original 20 Hz speed and approach onset are needed; immediacy remains a legal judgment.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Driver takes necessary precautions before proceeding
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Original clear, precaution and proceeding event order are needed; necessity remains a legal judgment.

requirement_dispositions.requirement: Avoidance of accident or injury to the protected person
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Original contact and physical consequence observations are needed; no legal verdict is inferred.
